meta.title: The Lantern Coast
meta.subtitle: an example of a calendar plugin: named ages
meta.description: A small fictional timeline whose years are named by ages, each counted from its own year 1, through the bundled lantern-ages calendar.
meta.credits: Example data for the Timelines app. Fictional; any resemblance to real history is accidental.

events.title: First landing at Sel
events.descr: Fishing crews winter on the headland, forty years before the Age of Tides begins.

events.title: The sea wall is raised
events.descr: Sel's harbour wall is finished. The logs count the Age of Tides from this year: Age of Tides 1.

events.title: The Great Storm
events.descr: A winter storm breaches the wall; the lower town is rebuilt on the hill.

events.title: The first lantern is lit
events.descr: The Wardens light the beacon on the point, and the Age of Lanterns begins: Age of Lanterns 1.

events.title: The glassmakers' charter
events.descr: Sel grants the glassmakers a guild of their own.

events.title: The glass beacon
events.descr: A lens of guild glass replaces the Wardens' fires, and the Age of Glass begins: Age of Glass 1.
